title: S027 — Validity-window dependency / reconsideration boundary validation
description: Validate whether adding fact validity-window dependencies (validFrom/validTo -> fact node) and correct member-first/fixpoint reconsideration reduces R \ closure to zero across the known failure corpus.
result_summary: HOLD. Added the S026 missing class to the reverse index (fact.validFrom/validTo -> fact.id). In this design the reset-to-NEITHER supplies member-first scheduling, so V1 IS V3 and V0 IS V2. RESULTS (400 prefixes per canon): verrin V0 mismatch=0 R\closure=6 -> V1 mismatch=0 R\closure=0; ordos V0 mismatch=186 R\closure=353 -> V1 mismatch=38 R\closure=67. So the validity-window dependency is NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for verrin (incremental Phase A becomes exact) but on ordos only REDUCES the residue. At least one further authoritative dependency class is missing from the index (hypotheses, not measured: overriddenCells -> fact node, retracted -> fact node, node-set changes). S021's aggregate remains exact; the gap is entirely in the dependency index. No incremental engine, no second evaluator, no heuristic edges.
note_v2_v3: In this design the reset-to-NEITHER supplies member-first scheduling, so V1 IS V3 and V0 IS V2; a design where scheduling is independent of reset was not built.
remaining_boundary: at least one further authoritative dependency class is missing for ordos (hypotheses: overriddenCells -> fact node, retracted -> fact node, node-set changes)
next_experiment: systematically enumerate and add the remaining authoritative Phase-A dependency classes (overriddenCells -> fact node, retracted -> fact node, node-set changes) and re-run the V1 differential; if R \ closure reaches 0 on ordos the boundary is compact (class A).
limitations: 800 prefixes total; no S024 synthetic corpus, no long horizon, no ordering-policy sweep, no queue metrics.
V2/V3 collapse into V0/V1 by construction in this design.
The remaining missing class is hypothesised, not measured.
